Garlic Herb Grilled Chicken Bowl🍗🧄🍚🥗 Juicy Middle Eastern grilled chicken served with fluffy spicy rice, refreshing tabbouleh, and a smooth, spicy garlic cream sauce. Every bite is loaded with flavour🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 650 Calories | 52g Protein | 59g Carbs | 22g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6) Middle Eastern Chicken - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Cumin - 30g Honey - 80-100g Tomato Paste  - 1 Lemon Juice  - 30g Olive Oil Golden Herb Rice - 300g Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand) - 20g Light Butter - 100g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Cumin Tabouleh Salad - 3 Cups Parsley, chopped - 300g Tomato, chopped and de-seeded - 150g Green Onion/Scallion, chopped - 15g Olive Oil - Lemon Juice - 1/2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Sumac - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes Spicy Garlic Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 120g Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee) - 1 Tsp Paprika  - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 1/4 Cup Evaporated Milk 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add the Middle Eastern spice mix, honey, tomato paste, lemon juice and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a pan over low heat. Add light butter and chopped onion, cook for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the seasoning and toast for 3-4 mins . Add cooked basmati rice, turn off the heat and mix until fluffy and golden. 3. In a bowl, combine chopped tomato, green onion, parsley, olive oil, seasoning and lemon juice. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve. 4. Spread the chicken on a lined sheet pan and oven bake at 200C / 400F for 20-25 mins, then broil/grill for 5 mins until golden and juicy. 5. While the chicken rests, whisk together yogurt, light mayo, chilli garlic sauce, seasonings and evaporated milk until smooth. 6. Serve with the spiced rice, fresh salad and garlic sauce. ENJOY! . . . . #grilledchicken #ricebowl #mealprep #healthyrecipes #chickenrecipes

YALL COME EAT it’s my viral sausage tortellini. 🤤  This recipe has nearly 5 million views on TikTok, so I thought it was time for an official step-by-step.  1. „Шоколадний трюфель“ (Truffe au chocolat) — прямо з мого кулінарного блокноту. Французький десерт із шоколадного ґанашу😋 ⠀ ep.27, s.1 ⠀ Інгредієнти: • Чорний шоколад (від 70%) — 1 міра. • Вершки (33%) — 1 міра = (1:1) • Dorblu (блакитний сир) — за смаком. • Ваніль • Какао ⠀ * Вершковість сиру Dorblu врівноважує виразну гіркоту чорного шоколаду. Солонувата пікантність додає десерту глибини та робить смак цікавішим. ⠀ Приготування: 1. Дрібно наріжте шоколад; 2. Підігрійте вершки разом з ваніллю до появи пари (80°); 3. Залийте гарячими вершками шоколад. Накрийте, та залиште на хвилину, щоб шоколад почав танути; 4. Перемішайте основу від центру до країв, поки вона не стане однорідною та блискучою = шоколадний ґанаш; 5. Покришіть Dorblu до шоколадної маси та перемішайте; 6. Накрийте ґанаш плівкою в контакт, та відправте до холодильнику — до повного застигання; 7. Сформуйте кульки, за допомогою ложки та рук; 8. Обкачайте кульки в какао. Щоб прибрати надлишок — струсіть зайве через сито. ⠀ ** Ґанаш (ganache) — емульсія шоколаду та вершків. Саме вона після охолодження набуває щільної, пластичної консистенції, завдяки якій можна формувати трюфелі; ⠀ *** У цьому рецепті я використовую сир із блакитною пліснявою Dorblu — справжній та єдиний від німецького бренду Käserei Champignon. Це легендарний та впізнаваний бренд, а не загальна назва всіх сирів із блакитною пліснявою ;) ⠀ 📚Ви можете детально переглянути інші рецепти та сторінки кулінарного блокноту в телеграм-каналі «Микита Сновида», за посиланням в описі профілю.

Visual artist Jason Cook  creates kinetic sculptures and robotic installations using electronics, programming and mechanical engineering. In The Walking Chair (2025), an ordinary wooden chair is transformed into a moving machine. Notice the GarlicDalek T did you? 😏😂 Follow the link in my bio for the link 💪❤️ HIGH PROTEIN HONEY GARLIC BUTTER CHICKEN MAC & CHEESE 9.5/10 — bloody lovely. 😂 Creamy, cheesy mac & cheese with sticky honey garlic chicken. Absolute filth, but somehow still 59g of protein per serving. WHAT YOU’LL NEED: Honey Garlic Chicken • 800g chicken breast, cubed • 1.5 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 1 tsp chilli flakes • 1.5 tsp garlic powder • 1.5 tsp onion powder • 1.5 tsp smoked paprika • 2 tsp olive oil • 30g light butter • 2 tsp minced garlic • 30g honey • Handful fresh parsley, chopped Garlic Mac & Cheese • 220g uncooked macaroni • 1 large tbsp minced garlic • 300ml skimmed milk • 160g light cream cheese • 1 tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper • 1 tsp smoked paprika • ½ tsp nutmeg • 100g low-fat cheddar cheese HOW TO MAKE IT: 1. Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, chilli flakes, garlic powder, onion powder and smoked paprika. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat with the olive oil and some of the butter. Add the chicken and cook for 4–5 minutes until golden, flip and cook for another 3–4 minutes until cooked through. 3. Lower the heat and add the remaining butter, minced garlic and honey. Give it a mixy mixy motherfucker! until the chicken is coated in that sticky honey garlic goodness. Remove and set aside. 4. Cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions. 5. In the same pan, cook the minced garlic in the leftover buttery goodness for around 2 minutes. 6. Add the skimmed milk, light cream cheese, salt, black pepper, smoked paprika and nutmeg. Stir until smooth. 7. Lower the heat, add the cheddar and stir until melted. Add the cooked macaroni and give the whole thing another mixy mixy motherfucker! 8. Serve the mac & cheese topped with the sticky honey garlic chicken and finish with fresh parsley. MACROS PER SERVING: 597 Calories | 59g Protein | 52g Carbs | 16g Fat SERVINGS: 4 Cheers: @jalalsamfit

Who needs a bun when the cheese does all the work? 🤯 These crispy chicken taco sandwiches seriously taste like a guilty pleasure, but they’re packed with protein! Huge shoutout to @Tasty Shreds for the inspiration! 🙌 Crispy High-Protein Chicken Taco Sandwiches Makes: 2 servings Ingredients: * 4 Just Bare Lightly Breaded Chicken Breast Strips * 4 slices turkey bacon, cooked and chopped * 90g Trader Joe’s Lite Shredded Mozzarella * 30g Sargento Reduced Fat Mozzarella * Very light drizzle of oil (about 1 tsp total or less) * Seasoning of choice (I used Fire & Smoke Society Honey Garlic Seasoning) Optional Toppings: * Shredded lettuce * Tomato slices * Pickled jalapeños * Protein ranch (plain nonfat Greek yogurt mixed with ranch seasoning) * Fresh chives Instructions 1. Cook the chicken strips according to the package directions, then chop into bite-sized pieces. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and lightly drizzle with oil. 3. Divide the chicken into two taco shell-shaped rounds, about the size of a taco shell. 4. Top each with 2 slices of chopped turkey bacon. 5. Mix both cheeses together and divide evenly over the chicken. 6. Season to your liking. (I used Fire & Smoke Society Honey Garlic Seasoning.) 7. Bake at 375°F for about 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and just starting to turn golden. Be careful not to overbake or the cheese will become too crisp to fold. 8. Let cool for 2–3 minutes until the cheese firms up slightly, then carefully peel each shell away from the parchment. It should still be flexible enough to fold. 9. Carefully fold into taco shapes, then fill with shredded lettuce, tomato, pickled jalapeños, protein ranch, and a generous sprinkle of fresh chives. Tommaso Mazzanti, CEO e fondatore di All’Antico Vinaio, lo dice senza fare il fenomeno: oggi non vuole più raccontare la storia del founder che lavora dalla mattina alla sera. Perché quella vita l’ha già fatta. Ha corso. Ha sacrificato. Per avere tempo, non solo fatturato. ❤️ E quando sente qualcuno dire “io lavoro H24”, la sua risposta è molto chiara: forse c’è qualcosa che non va. 🤯 Perché sì, lavorare tanto serve. Sì, sacrificarsi serve. Sì, all’inizio devi spingere come un pazzo. Ma il vero obiettivo non è restare incastrato per sempre nella hustle culture. Il vero obiettivo è costruire qualcosa che, prima o poi, ti permetta di vivere meglio. 🚀 Perché il successo non è solo quanto lavori. È anche poter scegliere con chi passare il tuo tempo. 👉 Guarda il video completo sul nostro canale YouTube per scoprire il resto della storia. #Chapeau #ceo #founder #AnticoVinaio #business

Here's an Italian dish you might not know about. If you've never had gnudi, think of them as the soft, pillowy filling of ravioli, just without the pasta! They're traditionally made with ricotta, often with spinach, but I wanted to give them a little fall twist with roasted butternut squash. And of course, I had to finish them with brown butter and crispy sage. Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

This recipe went VIRAL for a reason… and I’m convinced it’s the BEST Sunday dinner you’ll ever make! 🤤👏🏼 I’ve made these slow-roasted chicken thighs for 9 Sundays in a row, and my family STILL isn’t tired of them! 😂 Perfectly seasoned, melt-in-your-mouth tender, and packed with SO much flavor! It’s one of those meals that looks impressive but is ridiculously easy to make! Ingredients: • Boneless chicken thighs • Salt & pepper • Garlic powder • Paprika • Italian seasoning • Olive oil • 1 sliced onion (I use less!) • 2 cups chicken broth • Fresh thyme • Cornstarch + cold water (for gravy) Directions: 1. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish and generously season both sides with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika & Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and add sliced onions. 3. Pour in 2 cups of chicken broth and add fresh thyme. 4. Cover and bake at 350°F for 1 hour. 5. Remove thyme and pour the cooking liquid into a separate bowl. Mix cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then stir into the liquid. 6. Pour the gravy mixture back over the chicken. 7. Bake UNCOVERED at 450°F for another 30 minutes, until the chicken is beautifully browned and the gravy thickens!  And YES, I promise the broth doesn’t wash off all that seasoning. 😂 Just trust the process! Creamy Peri Peri Chicken Pasta🍗🧀🍝 Another game changing sheet pan meal prep. This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice This Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice is a cozy, comforting dinner featuring juicy golden chicken served over fluffy rice with a rich, buttery Parmesan garlic sauce. It's simple enough for busy weeknights but delicious enough to feel like a special homemade meal. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Add the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in the Parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and drizzle generously with the creamy garlic butter sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. Prep Time: 10 minutes | Cook Time: 25 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes Servings: 6 | Calories: About 620 per serving #dinner #easyrecipes #chicken #comfortfood #rice

Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

Creamy Chicken in 20 Minutes! Weeknights can get a little hectic, and sometimes you just need something quick and easy for dinner! Nothing beats a good chicken dinner, especially when it looks and tastes like something you’d order at a nice Italian restaurant! The best part is you don’t have to spend hours in the kitchen to make something this good. Pollo alla Valdostana Ingredients 1 lb (450 g) thin chicken cutlets 1/4 lb (115 g) prosciutto cotto (Italian cooked ham) 1/3 lb (150 g) Fontina cheese, shredded 1/2 cup white wine 1/2 cup chicken or vegetable broth (plus an extra 1/2 cup for more sauce) Flour Extra virgin olive oil Knob of butter Salt and pepper Fresh parsley Instructions 1. Heat olive oil and a knob of butter in a pan over medium-high heat. 2. While the butter melts, lightly flour the chicken cutlets and place them directly into the pan. 3. Cook for about 2 minutes per side, seasoning with salt and pepper. 4. Add the white wine and let it reduce for a minute or two. 5. Pour in the broth, then top each cutlet with prosciutto cotto, Fontina cheese, and fresh parsley. 6. Cover and simmer until the chicken is cooked through, the cheese melts, and the sauce thickens. #chicken #easyrecipe #fyp

VIRAL CARROT WRAPS 🥕 I’ve made a vacation of these with zucchini, pickles, jalapeños, and I had to put a spin on them with carrots. These are probably my second favorite after the zucchini, they come out really good, super pliable/ and they are a touch sweeter which went really well with the toppings I used here. A medium carrot has about 4 net carbs, so this is a great lower carb option if you’re watching carbs. Recipe makes 3-4 wraps Here is how I made it: 1.Preheat oven to 375F.  2.Shred 3 medium carrots into a bowl. Crack in an egg, add 1 cup of shredded pepper jack cheese, toss in 1/2 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/2 tbsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp chipotle pepper (optional), and a small pinch of salt. Mix really well. 3.Grab a cookie sheet, line with parchment paper (important!) and scoop the carrot mixture into circular shapes. You’ll get 3-4 good sized wraps here. 4.Pop it into the oven at 375F for 16-18 minutes. There are so many good recipes out there, but truthfully I’ve always had a hard time finding one that actually works for the season of life I’m in. My husband works late and I have two little girls, so weeknight dinner is on me, and most nights I just don’t have the time, the energy, or the headspace for a lot of recipes. That’s pretty much why I started making my own dinners, and I hope other moms, or honestly anyone, can appreciate them, because to me they’re actually so easy. DUMB DINNERS Broccoli Cheddar Chicken Orzo INGREDIENTS 1 box (16 oz) orzo, uncooked 1 tub (32 oz) Panera broccoli cheddar soup 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth 3 cups shredded rotisserie chicken 1 tsp garlic powder ½ tsp black pepper a few shakes Frank’s RedHot 1 bag (12 oz) frozen broccoli florets 1 bag (8 oz) shredded extra-sharp cheddar a big handful Cheez-Its, crushed HOW TO MAKE IT Heat the oven to 375°F. Spray a 9×13 dish. Dump in the orzo, soup, broth, and chicken. Sprinkle on the garlic powder, pepper, and hot sauce. Dump in the frozen broccoli straight from the bag. Stir well so the orzo is under the liquid. Cover tightly with foil. Bake at 375°F for 40 minutes. Uncover and stir. It should look loose and creamy. Stir in half the cheddar. Top with the rest, then the crushed Cheez-Its. Bake uncovered 5 more minutes. Let it sit 10 minutes before serving. Taste before adding any salt. #creatorsearchinsights #easydinnerideas #easyrecipe #easymeal #dinnerideas

This isn't a scene from a film. This is a heartbreaking reality that still exists in parts of Nepal. For some women and girls, getting their period means being sent away from their own home to spend the night in a small shed, away from their families. They are left to face cold nights, fear, loneliness, and the danger of snakes, insects, and wild animals—all because of a natural biological process. Menstruation should never be a reason for exclusion or shame. Take a moment and ask yourself: If it were someone you love—your daughter, your sister, your wife, or your mother—would you accept this as "tradition"? Some customs deserve to be questioned, especially when they put lives and dignity at risk. Every woman deserves to feel safe, respected, and valued, no matter what day of the month it is. Let's raise awareness, start conversations, and stand together to end harmful practices like this. Sticky Honey Garlic Chicken & Peppers!!!  Tender chicken coated in a honey garlic soy sauce with sautéed peppers. Sticky, savory, and perfect over rice!!!  Honey Garlic Chicken & Peppers  2 large chicken breast  Neutral oil  1/2 tsp salt 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp soy 1/2 tsp onion powder  1 tsp cornstarch  Sauce  Bell peppers, sliced (for sautéing) 1 tsp ginger paste or grated  2 tbsp garlic paste  2 tbsp honey  1/4 cup light and dark soy combined  1 tsp rice seasoning  1 tbsp hoisin sauce  1/2 tbsp oyster sauce  1/2 tsp Totole Granulated Chicken Flavor Season the chicken with neutral oil, seasonings, and cornstarch. Marinate for at least 2 hours. Cook the chicken in a skillet 2–3 minutes per side until lightly browned, then remove and set aside. In the same pan, sauté the sliced peppers until they reach your desired texture, then add the garlic paste. Pour in the sauce and simmer for a few minutes, stirring occasionally. If needed, add a 1:1 cornstarch slurry to thicken. Return the chicken to the pan and toss everything together until coated. Garnish with sliced green onions and enjoy #Foodie #cooking #food #honeygarlicchicken #chicken

Season your chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, thyme, and parsley. 2. Heat olive oil in a skillet and sear chicken 4–5 minutes per side until golden. Remove it and set aside with foil over it. 3. In the same pan, add olive oil. Add your diced onion and sauté about 3 minutes until soft. Keep stirring so it doesn’t burn. Then add butter & garlic and cook 30 seconds. 4. Pour in chicken broth to deglaze the pan. Stir in heavy cream, thyme, parsley, salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes. Simmer about 5 minutes. (Add cornstarch slurry if you want it thicker.) 5. Return chicken to the sauce. Cover and simmer on low 10–15 minutes until fully cooked and tender. 6. Cook rice separately… bring liquid to a boil, add rinsed rice, cover and cook about 15 minutes. Let sit 5 minutes, then fluff. 7. Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍯🧀🍟 By far one of the best combos i’ve made, all made around making meal prepping easy and effortless. The chicken is absolutely INCREDIBLE! Macros Per Serving (10 Total) 596 Calories | 54g Protein | 51g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Servings) Honey Garlic Parmesan Chicken •Marinade - 1500g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, cubed - 3 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 130g Grated Parmigiano Reggiano - 45g Honey - 8 Tsp / 40g Olive Oil •After Cooking - Extra 15g Honey - Extra 20g Grated Parmesan - Parsley for garnish Crispy Roasted Potatoes - 1800g Raw White/Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 4 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - Olive Oil Cooking Spray, 5 seconds spray Creamy Parmesan Tuscan Sauce •Blender - 700g Fat Free Cottage Cheese - 250g Skimmed Milk - 250g Light Evaporated Milk •Pan - 30g Light Butter - 200g White Onion, finely chopped - 45g Garlic, finely chopped - 200g Sundried Tomatoes, drained & chopped - Handful Fresh Basil Leaves, roughly chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 100g Grated Parmesan - 20g Parmesan Rind Chunks Cooking Instructions 1. Cube chicken thighs. Add seasonings, Parmesan, honey and olive oil. Mix well and set aside. Prepare cream sauce. 2. Cube potatoes and add to a lined sheet pan. Season, spray generously with cooking spray and mix. Spread evenly and bake at 200C / 400F for 35-40 mins until golden and crispy. 3. Meanwhile, melt butter in a large pan over medium heat. Add onion, garlic and sun-dried tomatoes. Cook 10 mins until softened, then add seasonings and fresh basil. 4. Toast 2 mins, then reduce heat to low. Add cream sauce, Parmesan and Parmesan rind. Mix gently until creamy. Do not boil. 5. Remove potatoes. Spread chicken on the same sheet pan and bake at 190C / 380F for 20 mins, then broil/grill 5-6 mins until golden and juicy. Finish with honey and Parmesan. 6. Add crispy potatoes to the cream sauce and gently fold until well coated. AI video editor in Claude Code: 3 prompts, from an empty folder to a finished reel. SETUP (once) 1. Get the Claude app (claude.ai/download) and open the Code tab, not the browser. 2. Make a folder "AI Editor" with 3 folders inside: raw, references, done. 3. New chat in Code → Local → Select folder → AI Editor. Needs a paid Claude plan. PROMPT 1: TOOLS You're my video editor. We work in this folder: raw, references, done. Install and verify 5 tools: FFmpeg with libass (on Mac: ffmpeg-full, full path), faster-whisper for word-level subtitles, yt-dlp for references, Remotion, HyperFrames (npm package hyperframes). Check what's installed first. Official installs only (Homebrew, winget, npm/pip), Node.js 22+. Python packages go in a .venv here, Python 3.14 or older: pip install faster-whisper "av<19". Test each for real: burn a subtitle into a test clip, transcribe 5 seconds of audio. Show a table: tool, version, works or not. PROMPT 2: YOUR TASTE Here are reels whose editing I like: [link 1] [link 2] [link 3]. My format: [talking to camera / voiceover]. Download them with yt-dlp into references (for study only). Study each one frame by frame and by ear: pacing, shot length, pause cuts, subtitles, colors, graphics, transitions, music, the first 3 seconds. Take inspiration, but don't copy: no shots, text, logos or brand elements. Write my own style to style.md with exact values. Show it and ask what to change. PROMPT 3: EDIT My new recording is in raw. Edit it using style.md: 1. Transcribe with Whisper, word timestamps. Ask me about doubtful words before burning subtitles. 2. Cut pauses, slips and bad takes, keep the last good take. Check cut points by audio level. Keep pauses that serve the meaning, breaths and word endings. Don't speed up my voice. 3. Word-by-word subtitles in my style. 4. If references/music.mp3 exists, put it quietly under the voice. 5. Graphics only where they help. 6. Export 1080×1920 to done as draft-v1.mp4 plus edit-notes.md. Check the file yourself, then show me. I'll give edits in plain words; save each as draft-v2, draft-v3. No code words. Follow for my own editing style, coming next.

Ragi Roti and Glucose Spike 📉📈 Is Ragi actually the "magical healthy alternative" we all think it is? We put it to the ultimate Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM) test, and the results were absolutely shocking. 🤯 Yesterday, regular wheat (aata) roti gave us a massive spike, leaving us super stressed. So, we tested the exact same weight of Ragi roti today, expecting much safer numbers. We waited a few hours, checked the monitor, and... trust me, you are not ready for this. My spike was a complete record-breaker—it matched the exact same spike I got from drinking straight pineapple juice!  And my mom's graph? It shot up even higher than the regular wheat roti! 📈 My mom used to have diabetes, but she brought it completely under control two years ago by giving up all types of roti. This test proved exactly why. I even pulled out the packets to compare the nutrition labels, and the truth about Ragi's fiber and net carbs compared to regular wheat will surprise you. The numbers don't lie. Watch the video to see the real-time graph and the final numbers! If you are looking for truly healthy, low-spike alternatives, check out my page for recipes like my Tofu Scramble, Gajar Ka Halwa, and Chocolate Pudding. ✅ Next up: We are testing Bajra ki Roti. Viral Bread recipe!  4 cups flour 2 cups warm water 2½ tsp yeast 1–2 tbsp salt Mix everything together. The dough will be sticky. Cover with a kitchen towel and let it sit for 2 hours. Transfer to a floured surface and knead/fold it 4–5 times. Cover and let it rise another 30 minutes. Place your Dutch oven in the oven and preheat to 450°F. Carefully remove the hot Dutch oven, place the dough on parchment paper and put it inside. Bake covered: 30 minutes Bake uncovered: 15 minutes That’s it. 🤯 The crust is SO good and the inside is soft and chewy. Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Rolls 🌯🧄🔥 Creamy garlic parmesan chicken, sautéed peppers and melted mozzarella, stuffed inside tortilla wraps and pan toasted until golden and crispy. 🤤 Recipe (Makes 3 Rolls) Ingredients: * ﻿﻿300g boiled chicken, shredded * ﻿﻿1 small onion, finely chopped * ﻿﻿¾ bell pepper, diced * ﻿﻿3 garlic cloves, crushed * ﻿﻿⅓ tsp salt (adjust to taste) * ﻿﻿¾ tsp paprika * ﻿﻿⅓ tsp black pepper * ﻿﻿⅓ tsp red chilli flakes * ﻿﻿¾ tsp chicken seasoning powder * ﻿﻿110ml fresh cream * ﻿﻿30g parmesan cheese, grated * ﻿﻿¾ tsp dried parsley * ﻿﻿3 large tortilla wraps * ﻿﻿90g mozzare la cheese, grated * ﻿﻿1½ tbsp oil for cooking Method: * ﻿﻿﻿Sauté onion, bell pepper and crushed garlic in a little oil until softened. * ﻿﻿﻿Add boiled chicken, salt, paprika, black pepper, chilli flakes and chicken seasoning. Mix well. * ﻿﻿﻿Stir in fresh cream, parmesan and dried parsley. Cook for a tew minutes until creamy, then allow to cool. * ﻿﻿﻿Divide the filling between 3 tortilla wraps, add mozzarella and fold tightly into rolls. * ﻿﻿﻿Heat a little oil in a pan and cook until golden and crispy on both sides. * ﻿﻿﻿Serve hot with crispy fries and enjoy! These homemade cheesy chicken wraps are seriously worth making, especially with a side of crispy fries! Cozy & Affordable Baked Chicken Dinner 🍗🤎 Tonight I was going for cozy, comforting, and affordable, and this is one of my go-to dinners when I want something simple but still really good. Ingredients: * Chicken legs * Olive oil * Garlic powder * Onion powder * Paprika * Seasoning salt * Black pepper * Italian seasoning * 1 orange bell pepper, sliced * 1 green bell pepper, sliced * 1 onion, sliced * 2 cans cream of mushroom soup * ½–1 cup chicken broth * Jasmine rice * French-style green beans * Buttermilk biscuits * Honey for glazing Instructions: 1. Season the chicken legs with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, seasoning salt, black pepper, and Italian seasoning. 2. Drizzle with olive oil and mix well so the seasoning coats the chicken. 3. Slice the peppers and onion. 4. Sauté the peppers and onions in a skillet until they begin to soften. 5. Add the cream of mushroom soup and chicken broth. Stir until smooth and creamy. 6. Place the seasoned chicken in a baking dish and pour the creamy mixture over the top. 7. Bake at 375°F for about 50–60 minutes, or until the chicken reaches 165°F internally and is fully cooked. 8. Serve with jasmine rice, French-style green beans, and a warm buttermilk biscuit finished with a little honey. Affordable, filling, and the perfect comfort dinner. Cross posting to 4 accounts has been a little crazy and ya girl needs a breather 😮‍💨 so enjoy! ☺️  ✨ Creamy Garlic Chicken & Mashed Potatoes 🤍🧄🥔 If comfort food had a personality, this would be it. Tender pan-seared chicken, creamy garlic parmesan gravy, and buttery mashed potatoes that soak up every last drop. ✨ 🕒 Total Time: ~45 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. Serve over warm mashed potatoes and drizzle with plenty of that creamy garlic gravy. ✨ This is the kind of dinner that has everyone asking for seconds and a piece of bread to clean the plate. 🤍 #CreamyGarlicChicken #ComfortFood #EasyDinnerRecipe #FamilyDinner

Gray/серый color/цвет. Что следующее?/What’s next? #gray #mycolor #pinterest #color #sliver Серый — это нейтральный ахроматический цвет, который образуется при смешении белого и чёрного (или при равной концентрации красного, зелёного и синего в модели RGB). В переносном смысле слово означает бесцветный, будничный, неприметный, а также необразованный или неофициальный. [1, 2, out 3, 4, 5] Подробную информацию о значении и оттенках этого слова можно найти в Викисловаре. [1] Физические и цветовые свойства * Ахроматичность: у цвета нет яркого цветового тона, он находится между белым и чёрным. *  * Оттенки: от светлого серебристого до тёмного графитового и мокрого асфальта. *  * Восприятие: успокаивает нервную систему и служит отличным фоном для других ярких цветов.[1, 2, 3, 4] *  Переносные и разговорные значения     * Тусклый и пасмурный: погода, день или сумерки без солнца. *  * Бесцветный и безликий: скучные будни, рутина или ничем не примечательный человек («серая масса»). *  * Малокультурный: непросвещённый или невежественный человек. *  * Неофициальный («серый» рынок, «серая» зарплата): находящийся в тени закона. [1, 2, 3] *  Цвет — это субъективное зрительное ощущение, которое возникает, когда свет разной длины волны попадает в глаз. В физике это свойство объектов отражать или излучать электромагнитные волны определенного спектра видимого диапазона. [1, 2, 3] В русском языке слово имеет два основных значения. [1] 1. episode 1 : one-pot dinner  —> one-pot chicken gnocchi 🥘 a healthy, creamy & high-protein dinner you can make in under 15 min🤌🏼 ingredients — 2 servings • 400gr chicken breast • 200g mushrooms • 200g broccolini • 1 yellow onion • 200g fresh gnocchi • 100g light crème fraîche • 20g low-fat shredded mozzarella • 1 tbsp olive oil • 1 chicken stock cube • oregano • garlic powder • black pepper • chili flakes • salt how to chop your onion, mushrooms & broccolini and throw everything into a pan with the olive oil. season well and let it cook for a few minutes. add the chicken breast and let it cook through while you boil the gnocchi separately. add oregano, garlic powder, black pepper, chili flakes & salt. once the chicken is cooked, add the light crème fraîche, chicken stock and a splash of the gnocchi cooking water to create that creamy sauce. finish by adding the drained gnocchi & mozzarella, mix everything together and let it melt into the sauce. per serving ~700 kcal ~60g protein ~65g carbs ~20g fat quick. creamy. filling. and actually good. 🫶🏼 save this one for your next 15-minute dinner. #healthydinner #healthyrecipe #dinneridea #cookingvideo #highprotein

Cleaning a fish tank doesn't always mean draining it. In this method, waste and debris are removed while the water stays in place. Tools like siphon vacuums and filtration systems pull out uneaten food, algae, and sediment from the gravel, keeping the environment clean without stressing the fish. What makes this approach effective is balance. Beneficial bacteria remain undisturbed, water chemistry stays stable, and the tank continues to cycle naturally. It's a low-impact way to maintain a healthy aquarium, showing how smart maintenance can work with the ecosystem instead of resetting it. This video is for educational purposes only.
